name: The Holiday Bakeoff
source:
You need to win your town's holiday bake-off, but you'll have to do it alongside the frostiest chef on TV.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/The_Holiday_Bakeoff]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
你需要赢得镇上的假日烘焙大赛，但你必须与电视上最冷酷的厨师一起完成任务。

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/The_Holiday_Bakeoff]Choices Wikia[/url]]
